śiva-sadbhāva.misses: ‘true existence of Śiva’ theism misses abiding in Śiva’s real nature

śivāvasthā.misses: ‘state of Śiva’ as achievement misses the condition that is Śiva

śānta.misses: ‘peaceful’ vibe misses settled quiet of unmodified awareness

śāntābhāsa.misses: ‘appearance of peace’—the quiet shining the verse names, not a mood halo

śāṅkarī śakti.misses: consort mythology alone misses the power that is one with Śaṅkara

śūnya.misses: English ‘void’ suggests blank vacancy; here a threshold that can disclose knowing

śūnyapañcaka.misses: ‘five voids’ checklist misses the five emptiness-gates the practice traverses

śūnyatā.misses: Madhyamaka import may over-specify; here emptiness as lived open of awareness

śūnyā parā śakti.misses: ‘empty supreme power’ paradox—emptiness as the highest Śakti, not nihilism

śūnyālaya.misses: ‘abode of void’—resting in emptiness as home, not annihilatory blank
